claim: The corrected Fisher Iris dataset has 150 observations, 50 per species; Setosa is separable from the other two species by petal length on this fixed dataset.
source: Fisher 1936, UCI Iris dataset DOI 10.24432/C56C76; corrected Fisher/R variant bundled with scikit-learn
canonical_encoding: UTF-8 rows: sepal length,width,petal length,width each 1 decimal, lowercase species name, comma-separated, newline after each row
study_limitations: In-sample separability only; not Fisher's original discriminant analysis nor independent test-set performance.
